Your .gitignore does not cover .sdlc/ (gitignore_covers_sdlc:false). It is currently ignored only by .git/info/exclude line 7 (`.sdlc/`), which is local to this clone and is NOT committed or shared. So `git add -A` is safe for you today, but any other clone, any fresh clone, and CI would see .sdlc/ artifacts (packets, backups that may echo source content, telemetry) as untracked-but-addable. Gate 0 will offer to add .gitignore to this run's allowlist so the plugin can append the entry as part of the run, making the protection durable and shared.
